name: dsers-mcp-server
description: Official DSers MCP for account, store, supplier-product, publishing, Mapping, order, billing, and tracking workflows
long_description: The official hosted DSers MCP service exposes tools for account and plan reads, store connection, supplier-product discovery, pre-publish product editing, Pricing Rules, store-product Mapping, publishing, orders, fulfillment, billing, packages, and tracking. OAuth roles and scopes control access, dangerous operations require explicit user confirmation, and asynchronous writes are checked through owner-scoped job status.

tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.description: Read the authenticated account profile, timezone, permissions, and subaccounts.

tools.name: get_plan_and_credits
tools.description: Read active subscriptions, plan benefits, and current AI Credit balances.

tools.name: get_plan_and_credit_billing
tools.description: Read subscription purchases or AI Credit usage, or obtain an invoice download URL.

tools.name: get_order_paymentlink_and_billing
tools.description: Search account-owned order billing records.

tools.name: recommend_apps_to_install
tools.description: Discover visible seller and supplier apps that are not installed. It never installs an app.

tools.name: find_feature_entry
tools.description: Find a DSers page URL when no MCP tool supports the requested feature. Ask before opening it.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List connected stores, supplier apps, currencies, Pricing Rule context, Shipping Profiles, and publishing capabilities.

tools.name: list_shopify_shipping_zones
tools.description: List Shopify Markets countries or regions for one owned Shopify store.

tools.name: create_shopify_shipping_profile
tools.description: Create one Shopify Shipping Profile with a zone and flat rate after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: list_supported_countries
tools.description: List DSers-supported countries with stable IDs and ISO codes.

tools.name: list_platform_shipping_methods
tools.description: List supplier shipping services for one platform and destination.

tools.name: start_store_connection
tools.description: Return the signed authorization URL needed to connect a visible seller or supplier app.

tools.name: start_store_reauthorization
tools.description: Return a reauthorization URL for one owned store.

tools.name: list_supplier_search_filters
tools.description: Discover supplier apps, categories, and supported search filters.

tools.name: search_supplier_products
tools.description: Search supplier products by keyword, image, category, price, and platform filters.

tools.name: list_featured_product_collections
tools.description: List curated product-idea collections.

tools.name: get_supplier_product
tools.description: Read supplier product options, variants, inventory, media, and source URL.

tools.name: list_supplier_product_shipping_methods_and_cost
tools.description: Read available shipping methods and freight quotes for a supplier product.

tools.name: list_pre_publish_products
tools.description: Search the DSers pre-publish/import list with stable pagination.

tools.name: get_pre_publish_product
tools.description: Read the editable snapshot and resource version of one pre-publish product.

tools.name: get_pre_publish_product_organization
tools.description: Read Category and Organization choices and current selections for up to 100 products.

tools.name: get_push_shipping_recommendation
tools.description: Read per-product, per-store shipping candidates while preparing a publish request.

tools.name: get_pricing_rule
tools.description: Read complete Basic, Advanced, and AI Custom Pricing Rule state for one store.

tools.name: create_pre_publish_products
tools.description: Add one to ten exact supplier products to the pre-publish list.

tools.name: update_pre_publish_product_content
tools.description: Update content, media, package data, options, variants, SKUs, or stock using a current resource version.

tools.name: update_pre_publish_product_price
tools.description: Update exact variant prices or one fixed price after preview and explicit confirmation.

tools.name: update_pre_publish_product_organization
tools.description: Update Category, Organization, or URL-handle fields for up to 100 products.

tools.name: update_pricing_rule
tools.description: Update supported Pricing Rule, cents, and store-exchange-rate sections.

tools.name: delete_pre_publish_products
tools.description: Delete one to twenty exact pre-publish product IDs; filtered deletion first freezes exact IDs.

tools.name: list_managed_store_products
tools.description: Search DSers-managed store products and Mapping status.

tools.name: search_store_products
tools.description: Search seller-platform products and see whether each is already imported.

tools.name: get_managed_store_product
tools.description: Read seller variants, supplier mappings, media, sync settings, and inventory.

tools.name: get_store_product_mapping
tools.description: Read the MCP-safe Basic or Advanced Mapping view for a managed product.

tools.name: simulate_pricing_rule
tools.description: Calculate seller prices from supplied or mapped supplier costs.

tools.name: search_ai_mapping_candidates
tools.description: Search visual supplier candidates and read the latest AI Mapping Job status.

tools.name: start_ai_product_mapping
tools.description: Create an AI Mapping computation for an exact product and supplier candidate.

tools.name: apply_ai_mapping
tools.description: Apply one successful AI Mapping task after a fresh preview and second confirmation.

tools.name: apply_product_mapping
tools.description: Update exact Basic or Advanced Mapping relationships and verify the saved result.

tools.name: import_store_products_to_dsers
tools.description: Import one to five exact seller products into DSers management.

tools.name: update_managed_store_product
tools.description: Update selected seller variants with explicit automatic-sync decisions.

tools.name: update_store_product_price_in_bulk
tools.description: Start a whole-store manual price-update task for one to twenty stores.

tools.name: publish_products_to_stores
tools.description: Publish selected pre-publish products to explicitly selected stores after a complete preflight.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Read normalized progress and results for an owner-scoped asynchronous task.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Search account-owned order summaries with cursor pagination and optional counts.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Read rich detail for one exact order, supplier platform, and order tab.

tools.name: diagnose_order_issue
tools.description: Explain placement blockers for exact orders or an order-search page.

tools.name: validate_order_address
tools.description: Validate the saved address against supported platform field rules.

tools.name: update_order_information
tools.description: Update selected address, note, supplier message, or shipping-method fields.

tools.name: update_order_supplier
tools.description: Change the supplier product or fulfillment variant for one order item.

tools.name: place_orders_to_suppliers
tools.description: Start supplier placement for exact orders or normalized order filters.

tools.name: update_supplier_order
tools.description: Start an asynchronous supplier-order detail refresh.

tools.name: sync_existing_tracking_numbers_to_store
tools.description: Send existing supplier tracking data to the sales channel after confirmation.

tools.name: update_tracking_numbers_to_store
tools.description: Replace selected sales-side tracking numbers and send the new list to the sales channel.

tools.name: create_order_payment_link
tools.description: Create the appropriate awaiting-payment checkout flow; it does not charge the user.

tools.name: send_buyer_tracking_notification
tools.description: Trigger an asynchronous Shopify buyer tracking notification.

tools.name: cancel_supplier_order
tools.description: Start cancellation of an eligible Agent or 1688 Dropshipping supplier order.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List account-owned tracking packages, including exception views.

tools.name: get_package_details
tools.description: Read tracking details after ownership verification.

tools.name: sync_supply_order_tracking_number
tools.description: Start an asynchronous refresh for one account-owned tracking number.

tools.name: list_supplier_product_change_notifications
tools.description: List mapped supplier-product cost, stock, SKU, and availability changes.
